title: Technical Theatre
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Associate in Arts Degree and Certificate of Achievement: Technical Theatre
outcomes: Demonstrate professional behavior as part of team implementing technical theater elements for a production.
Demonstrate safe construction and installation techniques for technical theatre disciplines such as scenery, lighting, or costumes.
Analyze a script, paying particular attention to technical elements.

blocks.name: Plus the following courses for ten and a half units
Plus a minimum of two units from the following (WE-186THTR is Preferred)

notes: The degree and the certificate share one section, one requirements list and one Student Learning Outcomes list ('Degree and Certificate Student Learning Outcomes'); recorded for the certificate.

The second block is headed 'Plus the following courses for ten and a half units', but its five listed courses total 13 units (3+2+3+3+2). Read as all required because 3 + 13 + 2 = 18 matches 'Units Required: 18'. The 10.5 figure matches the state file's units without THEATR-125 (3+3+3+1.5), so the heading may be outdated. Reviewer should check.
THEATR-186A is printed at 2.0 units in the catalog; the state file stores 1.5.
THEATR-125 (Color and Design for the Theatre) is not in the closed list; recorded as a catalog addition.
Catalog note: WE-186THTR is repeatable for up to 16 units combined.
The courses at the top of page 299 (THEATR-182C through Recommended electives) belong to the preceding program (acting/performance) and were not read.

The description names work settings (resident and touring theatres, theme parks, television and motion picture) and work areas (theatrical carpentry, lighting, costume construction), but no explicit careers or job titles; careers left empty. Reviewer may wish to check.
